items.title: Nissan says thousands of customers exposed in Red Hat breach
items.description: Nissan Motor Co. Ltd. (Nissan) has confirmed that information of thousands of its customers has been compromised after the data breach at Red Hat in September. [...]

items.title: Threat Actors Exploit Zero-Day in WatchGuard Firebox Devices
items.description: With attacks on the critical firewall vulnerability, WatchGuard joins a list of edge device vendors whose products have been targeted in recent weeks.
